title: An etale atlas presents an algebraic space as its relation quotient
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $X$ be an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $p:h_U\to X$ be a representable surjective etale map from an $S$-scheme $U$. Let $R=U\times_XU$ be the scheme representing this sheaf fibre product [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers], with projections $s,t:R\to U$. The map $(s,t):R\to U\times_SU$ is an equivalence relation: for each $S$-scheme $T$, it identifies $R(T)$ with the pairs $(a,b)\in U(T)^2$ satisfying $p\circ a=p\circ b$. The projections $s,t$ are surjective etale morphisms [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Let $Q$ be the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] on the big fppf site [def-pc-fppf-site] of the presheaf $T\mapsto U(T)/R(T)$. The canonical map $Q\to X$ induced by $p$ is an isomorphism and identifies the quotient map $h_U\to Q$ with $p$.

source.place: Tag 0262, lemma-space-presentation, clauses (1)-(3); the surjectivity of s,t follows also from their diagonal section.

proof.text: Apply [lem-a1-representable-etale-kernel-relation] to X.obj, the atlas p, and the supplied representative R. Representability follows from the etale scheme tests by forgetting the etale property. The sectionwise bijections identify a section r with (r followed by s, r followed by t). Their injectivity proves that prod.lift s t is mono, and their surjectivity proves that the represented relation is precisely equality of p-images. Retain the supplied equivalence relation and the four projection properties.

Regard the atlas as a sheaf morphism p′ from the subcanonical representable h_U to X.obj. Apply [lem-a1-representable-etale-fppf-local-lifting] to obtain local surjectivity and an epimorphism. Let q:h_U to Q be the actual presheaf coequalizer projection followed by eta. Equal p-images are represented by a section of R by step 1, so the coequalizer condition implies equal q-images. Descend q to the presheaf image of p′: at an image element choose any preimage and apply q; fiberwise constancy makes this independent of the preimage and proves naturality. The explicit subsheaf sheafification extends this map to the sheaf image. Local surjectivity makes the inclusion of this image into X.obj an isomorphism. Its inverse followed by the extension gives b:X.obj to Q with p′ followed by b equal to q. This is the direct image-and-sheafification argument of Sites Tag 086K, valid without sheafification of every small-valued presheaf.

source.place: Tag 086K, lemma-coequalizer-surjection, proof via the presheaf image and its sheafification.

proof.text: Let alpha be the already defined etaleAtlasPresentationMap. The inverse hom-set bijection in [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] gives eta followed by alpha equal to the presheaf coequalizer descent of p. Precomposing with the coequalizer projection gives q followed by alpha equal to p′. Thus p′ followed by b followed by alpha equals p′, and cancellation of the epimorphism gives b followed by alpha equal to the identity. To prove alpha followed by b equal to the identity, use injectivity of the given hom-set map h_eta Q and then the presheaf coequalizer hom-ext principle. The resulting equality is q followed by alpha followed by b equals q, which follows from the two factorizations. These inverse identities give the required IsIso instance, and the factorization is exactly the final clause of the statement.

lean.statement: theorem etale_atlas_presentation {S : Scheme.{u}} (X : AlgebraicSpace S) (U : Over S) (p : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X.obj.obj) (hp : IsEtale p) (hsur : IsSurjective p) (R : Over S) (s t : R ⟶ U) (hR : IsPullback (yoneda.map s) (yoneda.map t) p p) (Q : Sheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over S) (Type u)) (η : coequalizer (yoneda.map s) (yoneda.map t) ⟶ Q.obj) (hη : ∀ G : Sheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over S) (Type u), Function.Bijective (fun a : Q.obj ⟶ G.obj ↦ η ≫ a)) : Mono (prod.lift s t) ∧ (∀ T : Over S, Equivalence (fun a b : T ⟶ U ↦ ∃ r : T ⟶ R, r ≫ s = a ∧ r ≫ t = b) ∧ ∀ a b : T ⟶ U, (∃ r : T ⟶ R, r ≫ s = a ∧ r ≫ t = b) ↔ p.app (op T) a = p.app (op T) b) ∧ Etale s.left ∧ Surjective s.left ∧ Etale t.left ∧ Surjective t.left ∧ IsIso (etaleAtlasPresentationMap p s t hR Q η hη) ∧ (coequalizer.π (yoneda.map s) (yoneda.map t) ≫ η) ≫ (etaleAtlasPresentationMap p s t hR Q η hη).hom = p
lean.note: The canonical comparison is constructed by the inverse sheafification hom-set bijection applied to the presheaf coequalizer descent of p. Q and its unit are specified by the universal property at this quotient presheaf, preserving the published small-valued algebraic-space interface on the big fppf site. The representing scheme R is an arbitrary supplied representative, expressed by its Yoneda pullback square.
